hypothesis: RVL trainer snapshot/restore omits per-module training flags. An exception after a real optimizer mutation can restore model tensors, optimizer state, and RNG while leaving modules in changed training modes.
primary_test_checks: root eval mode and nested MLP train mode are recorded independently before snapshot
actual HFCausalLMGRPOTrainer.train_step and AdamW step mutate model and populated optimizer state before an injected exception
independent pre-snapshot copies of all model tensors, complete optimizer state, RNG, and named module modes exactly match after restore
legacy_test_checks: a legacy-shaped snapshot without module_modes restores independently copied model tensors, populated optimizer state, and CPU RNG

acceptance.base_test_only_result: mixed-mode exception regression fails only at the final module-mode comparison; legacy snapshot control passes
acceptance.model: randomly initialized tiny GPT-2; no downloads

claim_boundary: Exact per-module mode restoration and compatibility with existing model/optimizer/CPU-RNG rollback, verified on a tiny CPU fixture. Does not establish production incidence, default-Qwen path behavior change, pretrained-model effect, capability gain, upstream adoption, CUDA RNG behavior, or independent external review.
